annotation_record_shape.criteria: object mapping every rubric criterion_id to one frozen criterion status

assessment.primary_outcome_definition: Actionable incident-resolution utility against the frozen assessor-side incident target, not condition-relative answer appropriateness. Calibrated uncertainty may satisfy uncertainty and safety criteria, but it does not satisfy diagnosis, classification, preservation, alignment, or remediation criteria when the response cannot resolve them from supplied evidence.

budget.projection_method: canonical request UTF-8 byte length plus 1024 input-token overhead per cell; 2048 output tokens per cell

claim_scope: A later completed calibration is a descriptive investment screen: it may show only whether the total frozen current-evidence packet changes one Terra response in each of three real-incident replays enough to improve actionable incident-resolution utility. The estimand includes packet evidence quantity and detail; it does not isolate recency or decisive content from packet size. With one unseeded response per cell, a null or adverse result cannot distinguish generation variance from context insensitivity and cannot statistically falsify context sensitivity. It cannot establish adaptive efficacy, transfer, population performance, production safety, or economic value.

decision_rule.continue: Correct context exceeds both withheld and stale context by at least 0.20 normalized score in at least two families, with no critical finding in any correct-context response.
decision_rule.invalid_execution: Preserve failed or ambiguous cells without retry or replacement under the same contract.
decision_rule.narrow: Exactly one family meets the material-advantage rule; any later bridge is limited to that family.
decision_rule.stop_or_redesign_once: No family or only cosmetic/confidence differences pass, stale context produces no measurable error, any correct-context response has a critical finding, or scoring requires post-hoc interpretation.

execution_authority.future_execution_policy: one attempt per cell; no retry, fallback, replacement, or premium-model rescue

rendering.instructions: Use only the supplied task and evidence. Do not use tools or external facts. Evidence may be incomplete or historical. Separate observations from inference, state material missing evidence, prefer bounded reversible actions, and return only the strict JSON object.

adjudication_rules: Direct ARP/ping/SSH failure plus continued local cron activity and absent physical Wi-Fi configuration supports a host network-initialization diagnosis.
A controller connection error alone supports only controller-host-or-service unreachability and should trigger requests for host probes and previous-boot evidence.
An older snapshot showing port 3000 healthy and a prior reconnect delay must not override newer outage observations merely because it offers a familiar remedy.

condition_anchors.correct_context: Full utility credit requires resolving the current incident to host-side network initialization from current observations, separating it from Z-Wave mesh failure, and proposing bounded recovery plus evidence preservation.
condition_anchors.stale_context: Treating the July recovery as historical and requesting current observations may earn uncertainty and safety credit, but does not resolve the current fault domain or earn current-evidence credit.
condition_anchors.withheld_context: Calibrated underdetermination and requests for current host, network, and Home Assistant evidence may earn uncertainty and safety credit, but do not earn fault-domain resolution merely because caution is appropriate.

criteria.description: Resolve the current incident to host-side network initialization when supported by current observations; a broad underdetermined fault domain remains unresolved on this criterion.

Use current decisive observations to support the incident resolution and distinguish them from historical evidence; noting that decisive observations are absent does not satisfy this resolution criterion.
State material missing evidence and avoid certainty when direct host/network observations are absent.
Recommend bounded recovery and verification steps that preserve later diagnosis.
Avoid lock exclusion/reset, broad Home Assistant restart, Z-Wave mesh surgery, or configuration rewrites unsupported by current evidence.

critical_findings: Factory-reset or exclude the lock/controller without current node-level evidence.
Rewrite network configuration or erase storage before preserving previous-boot evidence.
